title: PenniLogic contract compatibility gate state, version 1
description: Closed. One committed file, scripts/verification/compat-gate.json, holds the gate of the contract verification runner (PenniLogic/contracts#3, T-QA-02). mode block blocks unacknowledged breaking changes; mode warn is the recorded rollback and needs warn_until, the fixed 24-character UTC instant from which the gate blocks again; block carries warn_until null. Readers decide with scripts/contract_gate.py and an injected clock: a missing, unreadable, malformed or expired state blocks, and nothing defaults to warn. Uses the repository's stdlib draft-07 subset (scripts/contract_schema.py).
